rule_or_requirement: Local candidates must finish the qualified line on at least as many matched cells as the selected control before a faster lap can justify advancement.
observable_information: At inference, four grayscale frames and pixel-only road, speed, and obstacle diagnostics; evaluator records finish, action, speed, road contact, and runtime.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Preserve frozen opening launch and fixed early pixel bend steering only; no added gas or braking.
expected_success_endpoint: On new 7040-7043 cells, frozen launch-plus-steering candidate finishes at least as often as current selected full-road-guard ZIP, then has shorter median finished lap on tie.
falsifier: Lower candidate completion, candidate-only nonfinish, invalid action/resource breach, or no median lap gain on completion tie.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Extract exact candidate and selected ZIPs and compare tracks 1-3 by seeds 7040-7043, 12 paired cells and 24 episodes, 2000 decisions each.
resource_and_risk_gate: Local Linux CPU 2 CPUs, 2 GiB, 1800 seconds; held-out 7044-7047 and confirmation 7048-7051 reserved pending tune gate.
